verdicts.reason: A keeps the original's centred stack and hierarchy, but the headline now breaks as 'and a / little sunshine.', which is a weaker line break than the original. The whole block is also squeezed vertically, with only about 30px of margin at the top and bottom and tight gaps between the headline, subcopy and CTA. B keeps the original line break and tries a banner layout, but the oversized headline nearly touches the left and right edges and sits too close to the bottom row. Its subcopy (wrapped to two lines and right-aligned) and the CTA are pushed into the lower-right corner, leaving the lower left empty and mixing a centred headline with right-aligned copy.
